frontmatter.description: The lakekeeper_warehouse resource allows to manage the lifecycle of a lakekeeper warehouse.Upstream API: Lakekeeper REST API docs https://docs.lakekeeper.io/docs/nightly/api/management/#tag/warehouse

The lakekeeper_namespaces data source lists the direct child namespaces of a warehouse, or of a namespace in it, that the provider's identity can see, sorted by path. It follows every page of the Iceberg REST catalog list. With an authorizer such as OpenFGA, Lakekeeper filters the list by the caller's permissions.Upstream API: Lakekeeper REST API docs https://docs.lakekeeper.io/docs/nightly/api/catalog/#tag/Catalog-API/operation/listNamespaces

The lakekeeper_warehouses data source lists a project's warehouses that the provider's identity can see, sorted by name. With an authorizer such as OpenFGA, Lakekeeper filters the list by the caller's permissions. The list contains active warehouses only (Lakekeeper lists only active warehouses when no status filter is sent).Upstream API: Lakekeeper REST API docs https://docs.lakekeeper.io/docs/nightly/api/management/#tag/warehouse/operation/list_warehouses

The lakekeeper_generic_table resource manages a generic (non-Iceberg) table inside a Lakekeeper namespace. Lakekeeper catalogs the table's identity, location and governance; engines such as Lance and Delta read and write the data directly.Lakekeeper has no update operation for generic tables. Changing namespace, format, base_location, doc, properties or schema replaces the table; changing name renames it in place.Upstream API: Lakekeeper REST API docs https://docs.lakekeeper.io/docs/nightly/api/generic

List the generic (non-Iceberg) tables in one namespace, sorted by name. Verifies the warehouse belongs to the project. No resources or permissions are changed.Upstream API: Lakekeeper REST API docs https://docs.lakekeeper.io/docs/nightly/api/generic-table/#tag/generic-table/operation/list_generic_tables

The lakekeeper_generic_table_protection resource manages the protection flag of one generic table in Lakekeeper.Protection prevents Lakekeeper from dropping the generic table. The generic table itself is not managed by this resource: create it with an Iceberg or Generic Table client and reference its ID here.Changing protected sets or clears the flag. The lakekeeper_projects data source lists the projects the provider's identity can see, sorted by name. With an authorizer such as OpenFGA, Lakekeeper filters the list by the caller's permissions.Upstream API: Lakekeeper REST API docs https://docs.lakekeeper.io/docs/nightly/api/management/#tag/project/operation/list_projects

Read an existing generic (non-Iceberg) table by its project, warehouse UUID and dotted namespace path. Verifies the warehouse belongs to the project. No resources or permissions are changed.Upstream API: Lakekeeper REST API docs https://docs.lakekeeper.io/docs/nightly/api/generic-table/#tag/generic-table/operation/load_generic_table
